senses.gloss: (√אש, v. אשש; cmp. אֵיתָן, אִית, יֵש, אִישׁ) to be substantial, dense, strong, hard.—Part. (as adj.) אָשִׁין, אֲשִׁינָא Ar. (ed., Ms. M. אָשׁוּן, אֲשׁוּנָא).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 155a">Sabb. 155ᵃ</cite> <he>חרובין דאשיני וכ׳</he> Ar. (Ms. M. <he>אשונא</he>, ed. <he>אקושי</he>) carob fruits which are hard … aftermath which is hard (dry). Cmp. <cite ref="J00699"><he>יָשָׁן</he></cite>.
